sql: WITH deposit AS (SELECT h.customer_id, SUM(h.market_value_amount) AS deposit_amount FROM fct_product_holding h WHERE h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' GROUP BY h.customer_id), customer_base AS (SELECT c.customer_id FROM dim_customer c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.region_code = 'EAST') SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 1000000 THEN '0-100万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 2000000 THEN '100-200万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 3000000 THEN '200-300万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 4000000 THEN '300-400万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 5000000 THEN '400-500万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 6000000 THEN '500-600万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 7000000 THEN '600-700万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 8000000 THEN '700-800万' WHEN COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) < 9000000 THEN '800-900万' ELSE '900-1000万' END AS deposit_band, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS customer_ratio_pct FROM customer_base cb LEFT JOIN deposit d ON cb.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0) <= 10000000 GROUP BY deposit_band ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE(d.deposit_amount,0)) LIMIT 100

sql: WITH customer_deposit AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(db.dep_balance, 0) AS deposit_balance FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT h.customer_id, SUM(h.market_value_amount) AS dep_balance FROM fct_product_holding h INNER JOIN dim_customer c2 ON h.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE c2.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c2.manager_id = 'M0001' AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' GROUP BY h.customer_id) db ON c.customer_id = db.customer_id WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.manager_id = 'M0001'), banded AS (SELECT customer_id, deposit_balance, LEAST(FLOOR(deposit_balance / 500000), 11) AS band_id FROM customer_deposit WHERE deposit_balance <= 6000000) SELECT CASE WHEN band_id = 11 THEN '550-600万' ELSE CONCAT(band_id*50, '-', (band_id+1)*50, '万') END AS deposit_band, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS ratio_percent FROM banded GROUP BY band_id, deposit_band ORDER BY band_id LIMIT 100
